rbac_enabled.quote: EKS relies on both Kubernetes and AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) features to manage access from users and workloads.

api_endpoint_private.quote: You can enable private access to the Kubernetes API server so that all communication between your nodes and the API server stays within your VPC.

control_plane_logs.quote: Amazon EKS control plane logging provides audit and diagnostic logs directly from the Amazon EKS control plane to CloudWatch Logs in your account.
terraform_properties: aws_eks_cluster.enabled_cluster_log_types includes api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, scheduler

secrets_encryption.quote: If you enable secrets encryption, the Kubernetes secrets are encrypted using the AWS KMS key that you select.

secrets_encryption_default.quote: If you are running Kubernetes version 1.28 or higher, your Kubernetes secrets are protected with envelope encryption by default.

irsa_oidc.quote: IAM roles for service accounts provide the ability to manage credentials for your applications, similar to the way that Amazon EC2 instance profiles provide credentials to Amazon EC2 instances.
terraform_properties: aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.url matches the cluster OIDC issuer

compute_mode.quote: Each Pod that runs on Fargate has its own compute boundary.
terraform_properties: aws_eks_fargate_profile is associated with the cluster or aws_eks_node_group is associated with the cluster

compute_modes.quote: Amazon EKS managed node groups automate the provisioning and lifecycle management of nodes (Amazon EC2 instances) for Amazon EKS Kubernetes clusters.
terraform_properties: aws_eks_fargate_profile is associated with the cluster
aws_eks_node_group is associated with the cluster

fargate_profile.quote: You can control which Pods start on Fargate and how they run with Fargate profiles.

fargate_not_configured.quote: Pods must match a Fargate profile at the time that they are scheduled to run on Fargate.
terraform_properties: No Fargate profile is in scope for this cluster

managed_node_group.quote: Node updates and terminations automatically drain nodes to ensure that your applications stay available.

managed_nodes_not_configured.quote: You can create multiple managed node groups within a single cluster.
terraform_properties: No managed node group is in scope for this cluster

addons.quote: Update the Amazon VPC CNI plugin for Kubernetes, CoreDNS, and kube-proxy add-ons.
